reasons: larchanka-training/dmc-268-ui-t6#227 has no `Refs` line naming an issue: the Spec and AC axes have nothing to check against. Add `Refs #N` (`Refs owner/repo#N` for an issue in the other repo) to the pull request body, or review the diff with `code-review` and name the spec
